result.summary: The page generally looks polished, but two visual issues stand out: an apparent loading spinner is left sitting on top of a restaurant photo, and a restaurant name is truncated in the horizontal list.

issues.description: A circular loading/progress indicator is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, partially obscuring the food photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the spinner disappears once the image has loaded, or replace it with a non-blocking placeholder/_skeleton state.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is visibly truncated, missing the end of the word (likely 'Piccola' or 'Piccolo').
issues.suggestion: Increase the card width, allow text wrapping, or use a smaller font size so full names are readable.
